name: unlock-face-id
title: Unlock Face ID
description: A Face ID style glyph with corner brackets draws in, a blue band sweeps over it, and on success a green tick replaces the face while the content below sharpens from a blur.
use: Sensitive content, recovery codes or account settings need a quick simulated biometric check before showing.
avoid: Anything relying on real security, because the scan is only a timed animation that verifies nothing.
a11y: A labelled button with live status text and reduced-motion handling; the glyph itself is hidden from screen readers. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: On a dark rounded card, four white corner brackets surround a minimal line face, with a short status line beneath and a blurred block of text underneath. On success a bold green tick replaces the face.
behaves: Clicking the glyph draws the brackets, then the face, and a blue band sweeps up and down across it. When the scan completes the face swaps for a green tick and the blurred content sharpens.
customise: Size, label, scan duration, error message and controlled status are props; children are the gated content. Colours follow the brand and green CSS variables.
weight: light: One SVG glyph animated with motion plus a single timeout while scanning.
demo: Scan to view recovery codes, revealing six codes such as 7KQ2-9FXM and H4TZ-1LPA
issues: The revealed recovery codes are small and low contrast against the dark card.
polishWhy: Convincing draw-in and scan sweep with a crisp success tick; the layout around it stays plain.
